_comment: Gold set for eval-flavor-pairing.ts. `good` = canonical Western COMPLEMENTARY pairs — by the shared-compound hypothesis (Ahn et al. 2011) these MUST show HIGH shared-compound overlap; aroma-CONTRAST classics (e.g. lamb+rosemary, coffee+chocolate) are deliberately excluded because they pair on perceptual contrast, not molecular overlap, so they don't belong in a complementary-overlap test set. `anti` = culinarily odd pairs (should show LOWER overlap than the good set). `crossCuisine` = LOW-overlap pairs scored under both a Western and an East-Asian cuisine to verify the axis flip (low overlap reads better under the contrasting Eastern axis than the complementary Western axis); only genuinely low-overlap East-Asian pairings qualify. All names in English to maximize FlavorDB resolution.
